answer: Proof of stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit capital to validate transactions. An attacker cannot simply forge identities to gain influence because consensus weight is tied to asset holdings, not network nodes. This mechanism transcends an ivory tower abstraction by imposing a ferrous cost on malicious actors; any attempt to hijack the ledger requires securing a majority of total staked value, making the economic price of subversion prohibitively expensive.
